label: root: down

label: floral disc: continuous

reason: PATO_0000689 continuous is a process quality. A continuous floral disc is an unbroken annular structure.

label: branch: discontinuous

reason: PATO_0000690 discontinuous is a process quality. 'Interrupted' here is a structural or arrangement break.

label: leaf sheath: continuous

label: spikelet: frequency

label: perianth lobe: persistence

label: inflorescence: nocturnal

label: fruit: frequency

label: branch: decreased rate

label: aerophore: up

label: corolla lobe: persistence

reason: 'Lobes persistent' means not shed. PATO_0000082 persistence is a rhythm (process) quality.

label: perianth: persistence

label: nectary: down

label: leaflet: up

label: stigma: up

label: leaf: duration

reason: 'Persistant-accrescent' is two qualities. The persistent part means not shed, a shedability quality. PATO_0000082 is a rhythm (process) quality.

label: petal: duration

label: calyx lobe: persistence

reason: PATO_0000082 persistence is a rhythm (process) quality. Persistent calyx lobes are not shed.

label: trichome: continuous

label: trichome: persistence

label: whole plant: duration

fix: whole plant (PO_0000003) + decreased life span PATO_0001604; 'parfois' is a frequency modifier
reason: PATO_0001309 duration is a process quality. A short-lived plant has a decreased life span, an object time quality, as decided for short-lived flowers.

label: bract: up

fix: bract (PO_0009055; ostiolar bracts of the fig) + erect PATO_0000622 (ascending PATO_0104355 if oblique)

label: anther theca: down

label: leaf lamina tooth: up

label: prickle: down

label: corolla lobe: down

label: leaf: up

label: arilloid: discontinuous

label: stem: decreased rate

label: disc gland: discontinuous

label: fruit: up

label: peristome: persistence

reason: A persistent peristome stays and is not shed. PATO_0000082 persistence is a rhythm quality of a process. This follows the earlier batches.
